name: Dextren Ward
summary: In the Stormwind Stockade, Dextren Ward remains a prisoner amid a bloody uprising. Before his capture, he dug up bodies at Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood and sold them to the necromancer Morbent Fel. Darkshire's town council has marked him for death.

sections.title: Grave Robbery in Duskwood
sections.body: Before chains bound him beneath Stormwind, Dextren Ward robbed graves in Duskwood for profit. At Raven Hill Cemetery, where sorrow and horror had grown, he dug up the newly buried dead. He sold the bodies to local practitioners of dark arts.

sections.title: Pawn of the Necromancer
sections.body: Morbent Fel, a necromancer whose rituals plagued Duskwood and swelled the undead ranks, was Ward's main customer. By supplying him with bodies, Ward helped spread terror through Darkshire. Stormwind authorities eventually captured Ward and brought him to the Stockade. His crimes left the people of Duskwood demanding justice, and Councilman Millstipe called for Ward's hand as proof.

sections.title: Chaos in the Stockade
sections.body: A rebellion swept through the Stockade, and Ward was freed from his cell amid the chaos. Armed and vicious, he seized control of his corner of the prison and uses fear to keep intruders away. Alliance forces seeking to restore order count him among their priority targets.

faq.answer: Dextren Ward is a notorious criminal held in the Stormwind Stockade. In Duskwood, he robbed graves to supply bodies for dark rituals.

faq.q: Why is Dextren Ward in the Stockade?
faq.answer: Stormwind authorities captured Ward for robbing graves at Raven Hill Cemetery in Duskwood. He dug up newly buried bodies and sold them to the necromancer Morbent Fel.
Councilman Millstipe of Darkshire wants Ward dead. He demands Ward's hand as proof of justice for the desecrated graves of Duskwood.

faq.q: What is Ward's connection to Morbent Fel?
faq.answer: Ward supplied corpses to Morbent Fel. He dug up the newly buried dead at Raven Hill Cemetery for the necromancer's dark rituals.

faq.q: Where can Dextren Ward be found?
faq.answer: Dextren Ward is inside the Stormwind Stockade, the prison in Stormwind City's canals. During the ongoing revolt, he is in one of its holding wings.

faq.q: Why does the quest require Dextren's hand?
faq.answer: Councilman Millstipe asks for Ward's dead hand as proof that the grave robber can no longer dig up Duskwood's graves or profit from necromancy.

angles.text: As an Alliance champion helping Darkshire, ending Ward's crimes brings justice for Duskwood's desecrated graves and helps reclaim the rioting Stockade.
As a paladin, you can see Ward's work with necromancers and fresh corpses as an offense against the Light and the peaceful rest of the dead.
As a priest, you can see Ward's desecration of Raven Hill's burial ground as a matter of moral and spiritual restitution.
